answer: The wander index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the reef queue while honest participants promoted earlier goes on earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1622 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the pearl. A farm of 135 pays that 170 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
